continuity_scope: Free League's licensed tabletop roleplaying game The One Ring, second-edition Core Rules (2022 product/rights notice), limited to the accessible official Core Rules product page, official game page, and official Core Rules errata. This is a rules adaptation of Tolkien's Middle-earth, not a replacement witness for Tolkien's literary characters or events. It does not merge the Tolkien literary passes SRC-031/026, first edition, the 5E Lord of the Rings Roleplaying adaptation, Adventures in Middle-earth, starter sets, expansions, Black Library-style unrelated works, videogames, fan material, or home campaigns.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Second edition; Free League official product page, rights notice © 2022 Sophisticated Games Ltd.
Free League official overview of the second-edition game, setting frame, and key features.
Official Core Rules corrections for first and second printings; version-sensitive rules witness.

coverage_rule: Terms-only licensed-rules audit. The accessible official Core Rules material establishes the product's mechanics and adaptation frame, but it does not give a bounded, claim-level dramatic-character corpus appropriate for duplicating Tolkien characters. No character or relationship records are made. Heroic cultures, callings, patrons, the Shadow, journeys, items, places, adversary types, and mechanics remain terms/dimensions. Any direct named-character record requires a separate exact official rulebook or adventure witness with claim-level profile evidence and must remain distinguished from Tolkien literary canon.
omissions: All named literary Middle-earth figures, including the named patrons mentioned in product description, because this pass does not duplicate Tolkien character records from a licensed game overview.
Pre-generated heroes, Landmark-adventure figures, and all named NPCs from starter sets or supplements, which require separate product-specific passes.
Heroic cultures, callings, patrons, the Shadow, journeys, magical treasures, adversary types, places, and rules as character nodes.
The One Ring first edition, Tolkien literary texts, Adventures in Middle-earth, The Lord of the Rings Roleplaying 5E, all expansions, adaptations, fan creations, and home-campaign results.
uncertainties: The core product page announces information on six patrons, including Bilbo Baggins and Gandalf the Grey, but accessible product copy does not supply a bounded claim-level profile set; no identities, attributes, or relationships are inferred from it.
The official errata corrects first and second printings. It supersedes affected printed mechanics only where its individual entries say so; it is not treated as literary or timeline retcon evidence.

The core game is explicitly a licensed adaptation designed to evoke The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings. Its campaign framing and rules vocabulary can differ from a literary source without establishing a new fact about the literary canon.
evidence_basis: Free League official product, game-overview, and errata material only. The Core Rules page identifies the game as an official tabletop RPG based on Tolkien's works, its second-edition status, Eriador focus, and rules features; the game page supplies the 2965 Third Age campaign frame and core game vocabulary; the official errata identifies corrections to the first and second printings. No wiki, unofficial conversion, or fan source is used.
